The token occupies exactly one of two places. Both people observe the initial placement; its bit is one minus the later message bit.
The actual current world location varies independently of the message content. The message may be false without the recipient knowing that it is false.
The recipient has no observation of the token after the initial placement and learns no new location except by fully reading the specified delivered message.
The recipient treats this service's message as authoritative, accepts its location claim even if false, and replaces the remembered initial location.
